description: Universidad del Valle publishes labelled point clouds of 36,026 vehicles passing one toll station in Colombia. A LiDAR sensor and Doppler speed sensors captured six vehicle classes, including buses and several truck groups. Zenodo provides the named archive for free under CC BY 4.0. The observations can calibrate road-traffic classifiers or validate vehicle counts and fleet composition used in toll-road simulations. Site coverage is limited to the instrumented station; the deposit metadata reviewed does not establish a collection period or representative regional traffic mix. Cars and light vans dominate the classes, which limits balance for heavy-vehicle models. Point-cloud coordinates and labelling quality were not independently checked. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: A Point Cloud Dataset of Vehicles Passing Through a Toll Station for use in Training Classification Algorithms
notes: G4-0493; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
